name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | Onboarding, Adoption, Renewals & Data-Driven Account Health
summary: Customer success manager with 15+ years in B2B SaaS who owns the customer from onboarding through renewal. Retained all but one of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye (~94%) by tracking utilization and acting on adoption gaps before renewal, and onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 120% of sales targets. Analyzes account data in Excel, Power BI, and SQL and turns it into action plans. Sold and scoped software for architecture and engineering firms at Accelo, and as a founder builds the processes and documentation a growing team runs on.

Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion, and build SOPs for repeatable processes.
Expand scope with existing clients, identifying complementary services and writing the proposals and statements of work to close them.
